draft_text: Wrenfold's advantage over Fennick-Base may extend to customer-service domains not seen in training.
revised_text: Wrenfold outperforms Fennick-Base on the unseen test set of the Banking and Travel domains it was trained on (93.1 vs 91.6 and 92.4 vs 90.9 macro-F1).
rationale: The evidence (T1.r1, T1.r2) shows Wrenfold beats Fennick-Base on the unseen test set of the two trained domains. No evaluation on any domain not seen in training exists, so the claim that the advantage "may extend to customer-service domains not seen in training" is unsupported; the supported claim is limited to the evaluated Banking and Travel test sets.
